title: A Clock for the Regiment
author: Ivo Dunmore
blurb: Ansel Hartwell, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
